title: AI Value Realization
blurb: Consulting demonstration on where AI value concentrates and how to scale high-value workflows.

slides.title: AI value is broad in theory — but concentrated in execution
bullets: A six-page consulting demonstration showing how evidence, analytical charts and an action storyline become an editable PowerPoint.
The modeled portfolio shifts investment from scattered pilots to four repeatable workflows.

slides.title: The first 90 days should lock two workflows and the operating system around them
bullets: Select two workflows with clear owners, baseline economics and measurable adoption.
Build evaluation, risk controls and usage telemetry into the working process.
Redesign roles, train teams and fund reusable workflow components.
Stop weak pilots and move capacity toward proven value pools.
Board decision: approve the two-workflow portfolio and assign one accountable business owner per workflow.
